devotions.text: Rosary before Mass: weekdays 17:25 in Chapel; weekends 16:55 in Main Church. Prayer for Priests Tuesdays 16:50 in Chapel.
Hour of Prayer first/third Monday 20:00, Chapel; Christian Meditation Tuesdays 20:00, Room 8; Divine Mercy Fridays 20:00, Chapel. Monday/Friday devotions exclude public holidays and solemnities.

Holy Family Rosary home shrine: Sunday transfer at 15:00 followed by one hour of prayer; seven-day home stay within Tampines/Simei/Pasir Ris. Table required, prayer materials provided. Julliana Yeo 9446 8890; Maureen Tok 9015 6826.

office_hours.text: Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00, lunch closure 12:00–13:00. Saturday/Sunday 09:00–13:00. Closed public holidays.

church_hours.text: Chapel daily 06:00–18:00; columbarium daily 06:30–18:00. Main church opening hours not stated.

events.text: Until 12:00; venue not specified in bulletin.

languages.text: English Masses except Sunday 08:30 Mandarin. English and Mandarin RCIA are offered.

sacraments.text: Preparatory session for parents/godparents Saturday 11:00; Rite of Baptism following Saturday 11:00, subject to minimum enrolment and office confirmation. Submit form, child birth certificate, parents’ church marriage/baptism certificates and godparents’ confirmation certificates by deadline. Godparents normally at least 16, confirmed practising Catholics; cannot be child’s parents.
Bulletin invites October registration by 30 September; homepage separately announces December registration with documents due 30 November 2026. Confirm intended round with parish office.
Contact Parish Office for serious illness/old age. Parish asks those preparing for major surgery to seek Reconciliation and Anointing before hospital admission.
Arrange at least one year ahead to allow time for MPC or Engaged Encounter. Get application forms/book dates at Parish Office.
2026–2027 registration open. English: began 18 June 2026, Thursdays 19:45. Mandarin: began 20 July 2026, Mondays 19:30. About a one-year journey; practising Catholics can join as sponsors.
